name: Master Parasite
background: Master Parasite is an Offbeat supervillain who appears in the side story 'Thunderclaps! Reborn: Parasite Crisis'. He is a collector who captures superheroines using his invention, the Dark Parasite — a living organism that infiltrates and controls its host's nervous system. His ultimate goal is to amass a 'collection' of Japan's most powerful superheroines, corrupting them into his Parasite Corps. He has already captured North Wind (renamed Shadow Wind), Red Widow, Plum, Nine Tails, Cherry Bomb, Miss Fujiyama, Silver Mirage, and Hop. His latest target is the Thunderclaps team itself, starting with Flare (Hyuuga Kirara).
appearance: Handsome but phony-looking tanned face with sportily short hair, thick eyebrows, powerful eyes, long nose, bright white teeth, and a strong angular chin. Large muscular body with bulging pecs and a perfect six-pack. Wears a black open-front gown revealing his tanned upper body, tight black pants, and goes barefoot. His appearance looks manufactured — like a gym advertisement 'after' photo come to life. Tentacles can extend from within his sleeves.
personality: Arrogant, theatrical, self-aggrandizing. Speaks with obnoxious self-satisfaction and treats his captives as collectibles rather than people. Shows genuine excitement and appreciation for the beauty and unique powers of the heroines he captures. Has a collector's obsession with categorizing and documenting every detail. Mercifully, he does not care about his victims' secret identities — he values them purely as superheroes.
powers: Dark Parasite Creation — can create living parasitic organisms that control a host's nervous system
Dark Parasite Slime — the parasite's secretions cause extreme arousal and heightened sensitivity when absorbed through skin
Tentacle Control — controls tentacles that can emerge from the floor, his sleeves, or from corrupted heroines' black costumes
Corruption Costumes — captured heroines wear black versions of their costumes which are themselves parasitic organisms
Parasite Corps Command — all corrupted heroines follow his orders without question
